Which write-tool operations are classified as non-mutating?
Above what raw score threshold does the LLM judge bucket a score as 1.0?
How does the counterfactual reward assign credit to an individual write operation?
train.a: per_op_counterfactual replays the full ops_log to get a full_state_score. For each mutating op index it replays a leave-one-out variant (skipping that mutating op), re-scores the QA battery, and records the mean score delta relative to the full_state. Each op's marginal utility = that mean score delta. Trajectory reward = sum(per-op deltas) − cost_per_mut * n_mutating_ops. WriteReward typically supplies cost_per_op (default 0.001) so effective per-op penalty is typically 0.001. [src: mempol/eval/counterfactual.py]
